name: QEVD
description: QEVD is a benchmark and dataset for evaluating vision-language models in live fitness coaching scenarios, requiring models to recognize complex human actions, identify mistakes, and provide timely feedback in asynchronous, real-time interactions.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for multimodal fitness-coaching understanding, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on asynchronous situated interaction in fitness coaching; highlights limitations of current vision-language models.
